_source: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited: DRHP dated 11-May-2026 (SEBI filing 101528; printed page = PDF page - 5), restated financials to 31-Dec-2025, Rs million converted to Rs crore. The RHP is on nsearchives.nseindia.com (not reachable here) and was not posted on SEBI by 26-Oct-2026, so price band (Rs 153-162), lot (91), issue split (fresh 1.36 crore + OFS 0.34 crore shares) and dates come from the NSE issue page (read 26-Oct-2026). Valuation base = 9M FY26 annualised (x4/3) because the promoter's proprietorship was merged in only on 29-Mar-2025. UPDATE 29-Oct-2026: FY26 restated headline figures (revenue Rs 538.73 cr, EBITDA Rs 82.93 cr, PAT Rs 51.79 cr, net worth Rs 168.01 cr, borrowings Rs 68.44 cr, CFO Rs 15.40 cr, diluted EPS Rs 12.13) from the RHP as reproduced by IPO trackers; the valuation base is now FY26 actual instead of 9M FY26 annualised.

1.finding: Bonus issues of 2:1 (16-May-2025) and 2:3 (Dec-2025) are reflected: EPS 0.60 / 3.63 / 10.26 FY23-25 and 6.83 for 9M FY26 are on the 4,26,90,760 post-bonus shares.

2.finding: Operating cash flow Rs -23.56 / -9.53 cr FY24-25 (DRHP p. 228) and +Rs 15.40 cr in FY26 (RHP via trackers) against PAT Rs 8.17 / 23.26 / 51.79 cr; one tracker reports Q1 FY27 CFO about Rs -2.84 cr (single source). Typical for a jewellery retailer stocking new showrooms; most profit is reinvested in inventory.

3.finding: Current tax about 27% of PBT each year; income tax paid Rs 12.46 cr over FY23-9M FY26.

4.finding: Until 29-Mar-2025 the promoter ran a parallel proprietorship (M. K. Sons Jewellers), from which the company bought Rs 21.52 cr of goods in FY25; it was then merged in for 40,38,152 shares at Rs 176 (Rs 71.07 cr). Promoter loans (Rs 1.52 cr outstanding Dec-25) and showroom rent to the promoter (Rs 1.23 cr in 9M FY26) continue. Disclosed; the merger removes the overlap.

5.finding: Objects Rs 181.51 cr (showroom inventory Rs 151.51 cr + debt repayment Rs 30.00 cr) over 1.36 crore fresh shares = Rs 133.46 a share before GCP and expenses, below the Rs 153 floor.

8.finding: Five leased showrooms (3 Mumbai, 2 Ahmedabad; 6,513 sq ft); the two Ahmedabad showrooms gave 62.40% of 9M FY26 revenue. Finished jewellery is bought from third-party vendors in Maharashtra and Gujarat without long-term contracts.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities Rs 4.995 cr of income-tax demands (3.4% of Dec-25 net worth); no criminal or regulatory cases.

R1.finding: Paresh Rakesh & Associates LLP; FY23-25 restated from special-purpose Ind AS statements prepared from Indian GAAP books.

R3.finding: Fresh issue about Rs 220 cr at the upper band: monitoring agency mandatory; to be named in the RHP.

R6.finding: Aryaman Financial Services (sole BRLM): track record not compiled in this run.

rationale.g1: Revenue Rs 217.32 / 351.28 / 538.73 cr FY24-26 (+62%, +53%; FY26 from the RHP via trackers), partly gold-price inflation and the full year of the merged proprietorship (DRHP pp. 64, 189). The issue funds Rs 151.51 cr of inventory for a new Maharashtra showroom and an expanded Ahmedabad showroom in FY27 (DRHP p. 91). Neutral 18% / 22% as the showrooms open, then 16% / 12% / 10%; Bear 6-10%; Bull 26-28%.
rationale.m: EBITDA margin 5.92% / 10.98% / 15.39% FY24-26 (FY26 EBITDA Rs 82.93 cr, RHP via trackers), lifted by rising gold prices on unhedged inventory. Neutral 12.5% (between FY25 and FY26); Bear 9.5%; Bull 15% (FY26 held).
rationale.nwc: Estimate: Mar-26 working capital is not in the tracker data. FY26 CFO Rs 15.40 cr against PAT Rs 51.79 cr + D&A ~3.5 implies a working-capital build of about Rs 40 cr, so about Rs 225 cr (42% of revenue) from Rs 185.34 cr at Mar-25 (DRHP p. 226). Neutral 42%; Bear 47%; Bull 38%.
rationale.roic: ROCE 27.24% (FY25) and 26.84% (9M FY26, not annualised) (p. 101). Terminal ROIC 16% (Neutral) given the inventory intensity.
rationale.capex: Net debt taken as Mar-26 borrowings Rs 68.44 cr (RHP via trackers); leases and cash at Mar-26 not available and assumed to offset (Dec-25: leases Rs 6.30 cr, cash Rs 13.81 cr). D&A Rs 3.5 cr and capex Rs 3.0 cr are estimates from the 9M FY26 run-rate (DRHP p. 228). Fresh issue 1.36 crore shares = Rs 220.32 cr at Rs 162.
